why: A green check suite on a PR is the informational signal that native auto-merge can go; the merge itself is done by GitHub's own auto-merge, never by this rule.
notes: Phase 1 limitation: the check_suite webhook payload's pull_requests[] does not carry the PR's auto_merge state, so this predicates on conclusion==success and at least one associated PR (pr_count>0) rather than a true auto-merge-armed check. Purely informational -- task.kind run_workflow enqueues aesop.merge_eligible as a heads-up, nothing acts on it.
